question: Who developed the polyphase alternating current system of generators, motors and transformers, licensed by Westinghouse Electric in 1888?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nikola Tesla.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nikola Tesla** was a **Serbian-American inventor, electrical engineer, mechanical engineer,** and futurist best known for his **contributions to the design of the modern alternating current (AC) **electricity** supply system.**
